transcript.content: Hello. Thank you for coming in today. What brings you in to see me?
I'm seeking help because I've been feeling extremely depressed and sad for the past two months. I also feel completely drained of energy all the time, and it's making it really hard to function.
Have you ever had periods lasting several days or more where you felt the opposite—extremely energized, on top of the world, or hyperactive, even with very little sleep?

Yes, I actually had a phase like that for about a year before this depression hit. I felt this overflowing amount of energy and an incredibly high, euphoric mood where I was constantly on the move. I was extremely hyperactive and just couldn't seem to slow down.
During that highly energized period, did your behavior lead to severe problems in your life, such as needing to be hospitalized or causing major trouble at work?
I don't think it was ever severe enough to need hospitalization or cause major trouble at work. I was definitely doing a lot, but I'm not entirely sure if it caused any serious problems like that.
During that highly energized period, did you ever experience things like hearing voices, seeing things that weren't there, or having beliefs that others told you were completely unrealistic?
No, I have never experienced anything like that. I didn't hear any voices, see things that weren't there, or hold any highly unrealistic beliefs during those energized periods.
During that energized time, did you do anything unusually risky or reckless, like spending too much money, or did friends and family express serious concern about your behavior?

No, I didn't engage in any risky behaviors like reckless spending, and my family never expressed any serious concern about my actions. However, I was definitely feeling highly energetic and constantly active during that period.
Apart from that one-year period, have you ever had any other times of high energy or mood elevation that were more intense, even if they only lasted a week or two?
No, I haven't had any other times like that outside of that one-year period. That was really the only time in my life I've ever felt that level of high energy or elevated mood.
During that year of high energy, did you find that you needed much less sleep than usual, such as feeling fully rested after only three or four hours?
I don't recall having a decreased need for sleep during that period. I don't think I ever felt fully rested on just a few hours of sleep back then.
During that year of high energy, did you notice that your thoughts were racing or that you were talking much faster than usual?
No, I don't recall experiencing my thoughts racing or talking much faster than usual during that period. Even though I had a lot of physical energy, my thinking and speech felt pretty normal to me.
During that year of high energy, did you feel unusually self-confident, or did you feel like you had special abilities or a grand sense of self-importance?
No, I didn't really feel unusually self-confident or like I had special abilities during that time. My self-esteem felt pretty normal, not grand or inflated at all.
During that year of high energy, did you find yourself starting many new projects at work, school, or home, or taking on a lot of extra activities?

Yes, absolutely. I had so much overflowing energy that I was constantly starting multiple new projects at work and at home all at once. I found it really difficult to just sit still or rest, so I kept taking on more and more activities.
